Subject: Disclosure under Regulation 30 of SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure 
Requirements) Regulations, 2015 - Audio recording of the Q4 & Full Year FY26 Results 
Earnings Call held on Friday, July 17, 2026. 
 
Dear Sir/Ma’am, 
 
Pursuant to Regulation 30 of the Securities and Exchange Board of India (Listing Obligations and 
Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015 read with Para A of Part A of Schedule III, we inform 
you that the Audio Recording of the Earnings Call for Q4 & Full Year FY 26 held on Friday, July 
17, 2026 has been uploaded on the Company’s website. 
 
The website link is as follows: 
 
https://cdn.turtlemint.com/wp-content/uploads/20260717175229/Audio-Recording_Earnings-
Call_Q4-Full-Year-FY26_17072026.pdf  
 
 
This is for your information and records. 
 
Thanking You, 
For Turtlemint Fintech Solutions Limited, 
(Formerly known as Turtlemint Fintech Solutions Private Limited and Fintech Blue Solutions 
Private Limited)  
 
  
 
 
Prashant Saini
